feature: Ai/EPS PostScript lexical scope and data isolation

references.basis: Literal string escapes/nested parentheses; hexadecimal and ASCII85 delimiters; literal arrays contain objects.

native.expected: 62 red/blue artwork images and one blank no-artwork image

limits: Not a complete PostScript interpreter; no execution of arbitrary procedures, fonts or gradients added.
Hex/ASCII85 skipping recognizes boundaries; it does not decode and validate all encoded string data.
One opaque raw-data control follows DSC byte-count contracts and is excluded from native execution.
Original 90-case probe counter typo retained and corrected in discovery evidence; no initial source or native result replaced.
Array sources were captured after the first DSC patch and before the array patch; this is explicit in their baseline.
Merge/tag/Release/development upload remain pending direct confirmation after prior automatic approval review rejection.
rootCauses: Physical DSC line scanning ignored literal/encoded string boundaries, truncating vectors or selecting fake bounds/preview metadata.
Vector tokenizer treated any > as ASCII85 end instead of ~>, exposing string data as drawing commands.
Top-level array parser searched the first ] without string/nesting awareness, exposing string data as a phantom third path.
